manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Snapshots the local brainstem via bond.py and plants it onto a public GitHub repo with a continuation manifest and launch fingerprint.
manifest.name: @kody-w/launch_to_public_agent

_local_brainstem_dir.description: (test-only) treat this dir as both home + src for the snapshot.

_local_target_dir.description: (test-only) graft into this local dir instead of fork+clone.

_skip_push.description: (test-only) build locally but skip git push.

entry_point.description: First action the resumer should take (one sentence).

instructions.description: Markdown text — the continuation instructions any cloud AI will ingest to know what to do next.

neighborhood_name.description: Display name for the launched neighborhood. Defaults to repo name.

target_repo.description: <owner>/<repo> destination. New repo created if absent; existing repo gets bond-technique additive graft.

verification_steps.description: Optional override of the default verification checklist.
